blocks.text: The Sensitive Information page allows you to view Indexed Document Match (IDM) information, which enables authorized users to fingerprint documents containing sensitive data. These fingerprints are then distributed to all Data Loss Prevention (DLP) endpoints. This process helps identify when parts of these fingerprinted documents are exfiltrated, ensuring compliance with corporate data protection policies. The Endpoint IDM operates in parallel to the Inline DLP IDM. Enforcement and detection are independent and require reindexing of IDM files using the Endpoint DLP. To learn more about how IDM works, see Configuring Sensitive Information Settings.
This feature is in limited availability. To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.
The Sensitive Information page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create fingerprints of your organization’s critical and sensitive documents.
Manage indexed document matches, including disabling entries and modifying or deleting template associations.
Detect and capture full or partial document matches when evaluating Endpoint DLP policies.

Provide a secure method for authorized users to index sensitive documents directly from their endpoints using the Endpoint DLP context menu, eliminating the need to copy data to remote servers or external tools.

blocks.text: On the Sensitive Information page (Endpoint Data Scan > Sensitive Information), you can view the following:

blocks.item: Overview:
Total Size of Fingerprints: Indicates the total size of all distributed indexed document fingerprints. The admin can set the limit up to 100 MB.
Users Authorized to Index Files: Indicates the users who are authorized to index sensitive documents.

Settings: Click to view the Settings page. You can view details of the users and corresponding templates assigned to the user. You can also configure an IDM template and assign it to a user. To learn more, see Configuring Sensitive Information Settings.
Filter by File Name and Indexed By.
In the table, view a list of all the indexed files with the file details:
File Name: The file that is selected to perform the index document activity.
Templates: The template associated with the user.
Status: Whether the template is enabled or disabled.
Original File Size: The original file size.
Original Text Size: The original size of the text within the file.
Fingerprint Size: The fingerprint size of the file.
MD5: MD5 hash of the file.
Indexed By: The user who has performed the index document activity.
Last Indexed: Timestamp of when the index document activity was performed.
Modified By: The user who last modified the template.
Last Modified: Timestamp of when the template was last modified.
